headline: The Allen Institute for AI has released AstaBrief 8B, a small free model that writes cited science reports about three and a half times faster than the Claude-based mode beside it.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a real open release, but a niche tool with speed and quality figures from the maker itself.
importance_line: Researchers and research institutions can run it on their own hardware, even behind a firewall for sensitive work, but the speed and quality figures are Ai2's own and a small human test did not rank it first overall.
summary: Unite.AI reports that the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) said on 2 Oct 2026 it is releasing the model weights and training data of AstaBrief 8B, a small model that turns a research question and found excerpts into a cited report, now offered as "Fast mode" in its Asta science platform. Ai2 says Fast mode averages 51.1 seconds per report against 178.5 seconds for the Claude-powered mode and comes within range of it on quality, but in a small human study researchers preferred another system overall, and Ai2 notes most testing was done in 2025 and not rerun against today's top models.
notes: All figures are Ai2's own; the Unite.AI piece is marked as AI-generated and reviewed by editors.
